integrity: The mathematical proof is provided, a standalone checker supplies finite symbolic and numerical diagnostics, and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns an unbounded-frequency strip, two incoherently combined normalized Hermite channels and strictly positive Gaussian weight. It does not extend to coherent windows, other Hermite orders or finite frequency truncations. No nonzero signal attains the spectral norm; earlier pure first-Hermite endpoint results are credited. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: A tricritical one-third Gaussian threshold for mixed Hermite strip localization
